backlogged.summary: lib/telemetry.mjs still exports `lastExport(root)`, but after this diff nothing in lib/, bin/, or test/ calls it — planExport now uses readExported directly. It was the primary function before this change (used internally by the old planExport) and is now orphaned dead code.

Adding USERNAME/USERDOMAIN/COMPUTERNAME/HOSTNAME/LOGONSERVER to BASE_ENV_ALLOWLIST also widens filteredEnv, so check/repro child processes now receive these user and host names. They are not secrets, and SR-2 now documents them, but this is a small increase in what untrusted repro commands can see.

Because user and host names are no longer redacted, exported hub bundles can now contain the literal OS user name (for example in session_log.path) and host names wherever event data includes them. This is the identifying-data concern of B378, made more likely by this change.

readNewEvents reads each event file fully into memory on every export (fs.readFileSync of the whole YYYY-MM.jsonl), even when only a small tail after the recorded position is new. This is fine at the current scale, but a positioned read from `start` would bound memory and I/O.
